text: We often celebrate "app downloads" as the ultimate metric for library digital success, but a high download count can be incredibly deceptive. A user might download Libby or Hoopla just to browse the catalog, only to realize the wait times for a bestseller are six months long. If they delete the app without ever checking out a book, that download is a hollow victory. We should be measuring meaningful engagement and circulation, not just how many people have our icons on their home screens.
